events.name: New Jersey Devils at Winnipeg Jets

headlines.description: — Tanner Pearson broke a tie at 6:17 of the third period and the Winnipeg Jets beat the New Jersey Devils 4-3 on Sunday for their first back-to-back victories since mid-November.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tanner Pearson breaks 3rd-period tie in Jets' 4-3 victory over Devils

headlines.description: — Joonas Korpisalo made 27 saves for his first shutout of the season and the eighth of his career, Viktor Arvidsson scored and the Boston Bruins beat the Pittsburgh Penguins 1-0 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Joonas Korpisalo stops 27 shots in Bruins' 1st shutout of the season; 1-0 win over Penguins

headlines.description: — Roman Josi scored a goal and added two assists to lead the Nashville Predators to a 3-2 victory over the Washington Capitals on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Roman Josi's goal, 2 assists lead Predators over Capitals 3-2

events.name: Columbus Blue Jackets at Utah Mammoth

headlines.description: — Dmitri Voronkov scored on a power play at 1:01 of overtime to give the Columbus Blue Jackets a 3-2 victory over the Utah Mammoth on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dmitri Voronkov scores on OT power play to lift Blue Jackets past Mammoth, 3-2

events.name: Vegas Golden Knights at San Jose Sharks

headlines.description: — Tomas Hertl had two goals and three assists, Jack Eichel also scored twice and the Vegas Golden Knights beat San Jose 7-2 on Sunday night, ending young Sharks star Macklin Celebrini's points streak at 13 games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hertl scores twice in 5-point game, Golden Knights beat Sharks 7-2 for 4th win in a row
